hero.title2: and the heart of Shkodër right at your door.
hero.description: Located on Shkodër’s historic pedestrian street, just a 5-minute walk from the main transport hub, our hostel is built for travelers to rest and connect, combining custom quiet pods with mountain views and social evenings on the rooftop terrace.

heroHighlights: Privacy pods with curtains, reading lights, sockets, and lockers
Rooftop sunsets with mountain and city views
Historic home on vibrant Kolë Idromeno street
A lively, social atmosphere perfect for meeting travelers over cold beers and raki

quickFacts.title: Privacy Pods
quickFacts.text: Spacious privacy pods in our mixed dorm create a personal bedroom feel within a social space

quickFacts.title: Boutique Dorms
quickFacts.text: Boutique 4-bed female or male dorms, offering a bright, high-end sanctuary for peaceful stays

includedServices.title: Modern Facilities
includedServices.description: Clean modern bathrooms, hot high-pressure showers, and high-speed WiFi in all rooms.

includedServices.title: Shared Kitchen
includedServices.description: Well-equipped kitchen for guest use, including refrigerators, stoves, an espresso and ice machine.

includedServices.title: Community / Social
includedServices.description: Regular social events, daytrips, movie nights, family dinners, games and friendly staff.

includedServices.title: Adventure Ready
includedServices.description: Transport and tour arrangements, and free secure luggage storage, all sorted from the hostel.

addOnServices.title: Breakfast
addOnServices.description: Fresh, locally-sourced breakfast including morning espresso. Early take-away breakfast for hikers

addOnServices.title: Tours & Transport
addOnServices.description: Hassle-free shuttle booking to Theth (€12), Valbona (€26), Shala River (€35 - includes €5 discount), and Komani Lake (€36).

addOnServices.title: Guest Laundry
addOnServices.description: Use our washing machine (€5) and dryer (€2) or air-dry your clothes on our clotheslines for free.

addOnServices.title: Bike Rentals
addOnServices.description: Explore Shkoder on two wheels for just €5/day. Rentals located nearby.

extendReasons.title: Sleep well, still meet people
extendReasons.description: Privacy pods give you a reset button after a long day in the mountains, so the social side of hostel life stays a choice, not a chore.

extendReasons.title: Rooftop nights, unmissable vibes
extendReasons.description: Sunset views, lively conversation, and cold drinks make it simple to connect. It’s the social heart of Shkodër, where every night has a story.

extendReasons.title: Everything starts right outside
extendReasons.description: You’re already on Shkoder's main pedestrian street, surrounded by local food, museums, and nightlife. Whether you're heading to the Alps or the coast, transport is just a short walk away.

extendReasons.title: Staff who keep things straightforward
extendReasons.description: Honest local tips, fresh and locally-sourced breakfast, and help with your hiking route. We handle the logistics so you can focus on the trip.

experiencePillars.title: Your Adventure Basecamp
experiencePillars.description: Drop your heavy bags and get out there. We’ll help you sort the logistics for the [Valbona and Theth trek](/experiences/theth-valbona-hiking-guide), boat trips up the Shala River, and kayaking out on Lake Shkodër.
experiencePillars.alt: Hiking and mountain views near Shkoder, Albanian Alps trips from Scodrinon Hostel

experiencePillars.title: Right in the Center
experiencePillars.description: Step out our front door directly onto Kolë Idromeno, Shkodër’s main pedestrian street. From your first morning espresso to late-night drinks, the city's best food, culture, and rhythm are literally at your doorstep.
experiencePillars.alt: Walking down the Pedonale in Shkoder

featuredMoments.title: Movie Nights and Socials
featuredMoments.description: Whether it’s rooftop raki or exploring the local craft beer scene, we prioritize memorable moments that make it easy for everyone to join.
featuredMoments.alt: Traditional food event at Scodrinon Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Explore the Bicycle Capital
featuredMoments.description: Shkodër runs on two wheels. Grab a rental and explore the city's flat streets, lake paths, and cafes exactly how the locals do.
featuredMoments.alt: Bike tour event from Scodrinon Hostel

featuredMoments.title: River Days at the Drin
featuredMoments.description: We head out to the river regularly for swimming and sun. These trips are a hostel favorite, a chance to relax and spend the afternoon with a great crew.
featuredMoments.alt: Guests enjoying an evening event at Scodrinon Hostel

featuredMoments.title: Rooftop Magic
featuredMoments.description: The rooftop is the social heart of the hostel: mountain light at sunset, city views after dark, and a pulse that keeps going from the first drink to the last chat.
featuredMoments.alt: Guests relaxing on the Scodrinon Hostel rooftop at sunset

experienceLogisticsFeatures.title: Free Luggage Storage
experienceLogisticsFeatures.description: Drop your main backpack in our secure storage. Hike the Valbona to Theth trail carrying only what you actually need.

experienceLogisticsFeatures.title: Transport & Logistics
experienceLogisticsFeatures.description: We provide honest, up-to-date info on furgon (minibus) schedules, Komani Lake ferries, and Shala River boat trips.

experienceLogisticsFeatures.title: The Post-Hike Reset
experienceLogisticsFeatures.description: Return from the mountains to a hot shower, A/C, crisp linens, and a cold drink on the rooftop.

socialConnectionFeatures.title: The Drin River Escape
socialConnectionFeatures.description: Just outside the city, the Drin River offers a cool, scenic contrast to the Alps. We organize regular group swimming trips to our favorite spots along the water for a perfect, sun-drenched afternoon.

socialConnectionFeatures.title: Spontaneous Socials
socialConnectionFeatures.description: Whether it’s rooftop raki shots or exploring the local craft beer scene, we prioritize high-energy moments that make it easy for everyone to join. It’s all about the social rhythm of the city.

socialConnectionFeatures.title: Bicycle Capital Access
socialConnectionFeatures.description: Shkodër is best explored on two wheels. Grab a rental from across the street and navigate the flat streets, historic center, and scenic lake paths exactly how the locals do.
